card.name: Space before the next dose in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The space or separator right after a dose, volume or interval and just before the next dose amount in a dosing table or an either/or list of regimens.

modes.label: Between paired doses
modes.description: The gap between one dose and the next number in a combination or alternative regimen.

modes.label: Between table rows
modes.description: The gap between dose-and-volume entries in a dilution or dose-escalation table.

modes.label: After 'or' in alternatives
modes.description: The gap or marker before the second option in an 'X or Y' schedule.
modes.example: 2.5 mL q12h or<< >>5 mL q24h Use

card.plain: It fires on the gap just before the next dose number in a dosing table or list of regimens.
